overview.description: The Yorkville America MANGOS Plus Index ETF (FRUT) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Yorkville America MANGOS Plus index. The fund tracks a high-momentum index that provides exposure to public and pre-IPO companies considered to be leading the development of artificial intelligence across both the platform-layer and hardware supply chain. Holdings are tier-weighted FRUT was launched on Aug 31, 2026 and is issued by Yorkville.
